props.description: Live music for weddings and events at hotels in Denver, Colorado Springs and Boulder: the ballrooms and terraces, how a band gets in and sets up, and the acts we’d pick for each space.

props.title: Live music at Denver hotel wedding and event venues.
props.lede: Maybe you’ve booked the hotel already, or you’re choosing between a few. Either way, you’re picturing the music there. Every hotel has its own rules on sound and its own way in for the band, and we plan the music around them.

headingText.html: Here’s what live music looks like at hotels and conference centers around Denver, Colorado Springs and Boulder, and the acts we’d pick for their ballrooms and terraces.

props.title: Booking a band at a hotel

rows.text: Bands come in through the hotel’s loading dock or a service entrance, not the lobby, at a time the hotel’s event manager sets. We work out the time and the way in with them before your date.

Our acts bring a sound system sized for a small-to-medium event space. Many hotels have an in-house AV company, and a big ballroom may need more sound than a band brings, so tell us which space you’ve booked and we’ll work out what it needs with you and the hotel’s AV team.
Most hotels ask outside vendors for a certificate of insurance before the event, and we can send ours to your event manager ahead of time.

Hotels with guest rooms nearby often set an end time for amplified music, and outdoor terraces and lawns tend to stop earlier than the ballrooms. We plan around the hotel’s rules, and the band can bring the volume up or down whenever you ask.

props.title: Planning an event at another hotel?
props.lede: We book acts at hotels and conference centers all over Denver, the Front Range and the mountain towns. Just send us your date and the hotel, and we’ll take it from there.
